description: This file defines the interface CustomerService, which provides methods for managing Customer entities within the sales management system. It includes method signatures for retrieving customers by name, store, nickname, saving or updating customer data, listing customers based on criteria, and geolocating customer addresses via IP.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Interface for customer-related operations, extending a generic entity service for Customer objects, including methods for searching, listing, saving, and geolocation.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the specified first name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer identified by their nickname.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer or updates an existing customer record, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore (with criteria)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers associated with a store, filtered by specific criteria.

methods.name: getByNick (with storeId)
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname and store ID.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's address based on IP address via geolocation, may throw ServiceException.
